note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, values, units and quotes; both correctly bind the drivetrain values from the body text and Table 5-1. The only differences are cosmetic: A writes 'Rotor | Rated Rotor Speed' where B writes 'Rotor | Rated Speed', and A attaches the 'fully-deployed' condition to its second brake-torque claim while B embeds it in the attribute name. Both repeat the generator efficiency and the fully-deployed brake torque under two names, and both omit the 5% critical structural-damping ratio of the driveshaft. Neither set contains a misread, misbound or invented claim.
remarks: Both sets state generator electrical efficiency (94.4%) and fully-deployed HSS brake torque (28,116.2 N•m) twice (body text and table row) — same fact under two names. Both miss the driveshaft structural-damping ratio of 5% critical (associated with the free-free mode of a drivetrain with rigid generator and rotor); the driveshaft natural frequency is only referenced to the RECOFF model with no numeric value, so it is correctly not claimed. Reference values (DOWEC 5,025,500 kg•m2 equivalent LSS inertia, 0.35 MW loss at 6.25 MW) are also unclaimed in both, which is acceptable.
